subject: Trouble with holographic 3D VR projection mode and canceling my unpurchased Enterprise plan
body: Hi, I am wearing my Linux VR spatial headset and trying to project our FlowBoard cards into our native 3D spatial hologram meeting room, but the spatial gestures are unresponsive and the holographic menu says offline. Also, I am currently on the Free plan, but I need you to cancel the Enterprise contract that I will buy next year so I do not get charged, and can you export my cards directly into quantum neural link format?
